description: This file defines data structures, constants, and types related to SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language) for authentication, including metadata, certificates, endpoints, and descriptors used in SAML integrations within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: SamlAuthRequest
classes.description: Represents a SAML authentication request with base64-encoded request, URL, and relay state.

classes.name: SamlCertificateStatus
classes.description: Indicates the presence or validity of various certificate files related to SAML.

classes.name: SamlMetadataResponse
classes.description: Contains URLs and certificates related to SAML Identity Provider metadata.

classes.name: NameIDFormat
classes.description: Represents a SAML NameID format with XML attributes and value.

classes.name: NameID
classes.description: Represents a SAML NameID with qualifiers, format, and value.

classes.name: AttributeValue
classes.description: Holds a value for a SAML attribute, including type and optional NameID.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Defines a SAML attribute with name, format, and multiple values.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint with binding and location details.

classes.name: IndexedEndpoint
classes.description: A specialized endpoint with index and default flags for SAML metadata.

classes.name: IDPSSODescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for an Identity Provider's Single Sign-On configuration, including services and attributes.

classes.name: SSODescriptor
classes.description: Base descriptor for SAML role descriptors, including various service endpoints.

classes.name: X509Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate in XML format.

classes.name: X509Data
classes.description: Contains X.509 certificate data.

classes.name: KeyInfo
classes.description: Contains key information, including X.509 data, for XML signatures.

classes.name: EncryptionMethod
classes.description: Specifies an encryption algorithm.

classes.name: KeyDescriptor
classes.description: Describes a cryptographic key with usage and key info.

classes.name: RoleDescriptor
classes.description: General descriptor for SAML roles, including validity, support, and associated keys.

classes.name: ContactPerson
classes.description: Details of a contact person for SAML metadata.

classes.name: LocalizedName
classes.description: Represents a localized name with language attribute.

classes.name: LocalizedURI
classes.description: Represents a localized URI with language attribute.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Contains organization names, display names, and URLs.

classes.name: EntityDescriptor
classes.description: Main SAML entity descriptor containing role descriptors, organization, and contact info.
